notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for regional interaction subscription service reports. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs, standard MIM data elements, DDM handles, and the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, DDM FOM, dimensions, standard MIM, endpoint, and callback configuration. It verifies typed subscription and unsubscription HLAreportServiceInvocation payloads, passive-subscription indicators, association metadata, serial progression, and region cleanup without provider-specific headers, registries, names, or diagnostics.
